info.name: TimeEcho API v1
info.description:
# TimeEcho API v1 - Postman collection

Covers every endpoint under `/api/v1` plus the `/livez`, `/readyz` and `/up` probes, with happy-path and edge-case examples.

## Quick start

1. Start the app: `bin/dev` (or `bin/rails server -p 3000`).
2. Set `baseUrl` if you are not on `http://localhost:3000`.
3. Run **02 - Authentication -> Request magic link** with your real email.
4. Read the token from the email (dev: Mailpit http://localhost:8025, or `bin/rails runner 'puts SessionToken.order(created_at: :desc).first&.token'`) and paste it into `magicLinkToken`.
5. Run **Exchange magic link token**: it stores the API token in `sessionToken`, used by every protected request.

## Conventions

- **Envelope**: success is `{ data, meta }`; failure is `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.
- **Keys**: letters, sessions, account and pagination use `camelCase` (global Jbuilder `camelize: :lower`); stamps and stamp categories keep their documented snake_case/camelCase duplicates.
- **Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <sessionToken>` or `X-Session-Token: <token>`.
- **401 vs 404**: missing/invalid tokens are `401 unauthorized`; resources you do not own are `404 not_found` (never 403) so the API never leaks that a resource exists.
- **Locale**: optional `X-Locale: es|en` header or `?locale=` param.
- **Pagination**: `page` + `per_page` (clamped to 1..100, default 20); `perPage` alias accepted.

## Behaviour worth knowing

- `POST /letters` is public: a valid session email wins, otherwise the body `email` is used.
- `POST /letters` is limited to 5 letters per email per 24h in production (skipped in development).
- `POST /letters/:id/predictions` only works on letters that are **not** `pending` - archive a letter first to unlock the reveal.
- `DELETE /letters/:id` only works on **archived** letters (`422 cannot_delete` otherwise).
- Archiving a **delivered** letter returns `422 cannot_archive_delivered` (terminal state).
- `429` examples only fire outside development (`Rack::Attack.enabled = false` in dev); run them with the Postman Runner.
- The `304` example needs *List stamps* to run first so `{{stampEtag}}` is populated.
- Folder 10 is destructive teardown (sessions and account). Skip it to keep your data.

request.description: Process liveness probe. Always 200 while the process is up; safelisted from rate limiting.
Readiness probe backed by Health::CheckService (DB/cache/queue). Returns 503 service_unavailable when a dependency is down.
Cheapest round-trip: { data: { status: "ok", timestamp } }.
Full health payload: overall status, per-service checks, version and meta.totalLatencyMs.
Happy path. Dispatches a magic link and returns 201 with { data: { message, email } }; the raw token only travels by email. Limited to 5 requests per hour per email (429 outside development).
Edge case: malformed email. MagicLinkForm rejects it and ResultHandler maps :invalid to 422 validation_failed.
Edge case: no email key at all. params.require(:email) raises ParameterMissing, handled as 400 bad_request.

Happy path. Consumes the single-use magic link token, revokes other active tokens for the email and returns a fresh API token (15 min TTL) which is stored in {{sessionToken}}.

Prerequisite: set {{magicLinkToken}} from the email (dev: Mailpit http://localhost:8025).

item.name: Exchange magic link token - reused or expired (401)

request.description: Edge case: the same magic link token replayed after the previous request consumed it (or a token older than 15 minutes). AuthenticateTokenService only looks at SessionToken.active.
Returns { data: { authenticated: true, email, locale } } for the caller identified by the bearer token.
Edge case: no Authorization header, no X-Session-Token and no session cookie.
Edge case: syntactically valid bearer token that matches no SessionToken record.

Happy path. Defaults to active stamps in active categories, ordered by category then position. Response carries both `stamps` and `data` arrays plus `meta`. Captures the ETag into {{stampEtag}} for the conditional GET example.

exec: if (etag) { pm.collectionVariables.set("stampEtag", etag); console.log("ETag captured:", etag); }

request.description: Accepts a category slug (category), id (category_id) or category_slug.
q (or name / query) performs an ILIKE search over slug and the localized name JSON.
Edge case: status=all (or active=all) bypasses the active scope, exposing inactive stamps and stamps in inactive categories. status=inactive returns only deactivated stamps.
Edge case: conditional request. Replays the ETag captured by List stamps; Rails stale? answers 304 with an empty body. If {{stampEtag}} is empty you get a normal 200.
Happy path. Returns { stamp: { slug, name, categorySlug, categoryName, active, svgContent } } including the raw <svg> body.

item.name: Get stamp by slug - unknown slug (404)

request.description: Edge case: unknown slug raises Api::NotFoundError explicitly.
Happy path. Returns { stampCategories: [...], stamp_categories: [...] } for active categories that still have active stamps, ordered by position.

Happy path with the nested `letter` envelope. scheduled_at is interpreted in timezone; stamp_slug must exist and be active. Stores {{letterId}}. The session email wins over the body email when a token is present.

body.raw:
{
  "letter": {
    "title": "Carta a mi yo del futuro",
    "email": "{{testEmail}}",
    "content": "Hoy cierro una etapa y quiero guardar este instante exacto: la mesa llena de cajas, el cafe frio y la ilusion intacta por lo que viene. Si estas leyendo esto dentro de un ano, espero que hayas dado el primer paso.",
    "scheduled_at": "2027-03-01 09:00",
    "timezone": "America/Bogota",
    "language": "es",
    "stamp_slug": "morning-coffee",
    "happiness_level": 8,
    "anxiety_level": 4,
    "motivation_level": 9,
    "prediction_city": "Vivir en Barcelona",
    "prediction_salary": "Mas de 3000 al mes",
    "prediction_relationship": "Seguir con Ana",
    "prediction_career": "Trabajar en mi propio estudio",
    "prediction_achievement": "Correr mi primera maraton",
    "prediction_happiness": "Ser mas feliz que hoy"
  }
}

item.name: Create letter - flat payload + nested attributes (201)

request.description: Happy path without the `letter` wrapper. Demonstrates the alternative emotional_snapshot_attributes and predictions_attributes shapes; predictions_attributes accepts an array of { category, prediction } (city, salary, relationship, career, achievement, happiness).

exec: pm.test("emotional snapshot built from nested attributes", () => pm.expect(body.data.emotionalSnapshot.happinessLevel).to.eql(7));

request.description: Edge case / design decision: POST /letters has no authenticate_user! filter, so an anonymous client can create a capsule for any email. Used later to prove that reading someone else's letter returns 404.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Carta de otra persona",
  "email": "{{otherEmail}}",
  "content": "Esta carta pertenece a otra persona y se crea sin sesion para comprobar que un token ajeno recibe un 404 y nunca un 403 en TimeEcho.",
  "scheduled_at": "2027-01-10 08:00",
  "timezone": "America/Bogota",
  "language": "es",
  "stamp_slug": "way-home"
}

request.description: Edge case: title below 3 chars, content below 80 chars and below 10 words. LetterForm reports both and ResultHandler returns 422 validation_failed with a details hash.

request.description: Edge case: truncated JSON triggers ActionDispatch::Http::Parameters::ParseError, translated to 400 bad_request.
Happy path: the caller's non-archived timeline ordered by scheduledAt, eager-loaded with stamp, emotional snapshot and predictions.
Happy path for the archive view. status=archived is equivalent.
Edge case: per_page is clamped to 1..100 (default 20), so per_page=0 falls back to 20 and per_page=500 returns 100. perPage is accepted as an alias.
Edge case: the timeline is private, so a missing token returns 401 (not 404).
Happy path for the detail view, including predictions[] with their outcome (pending | fulfilled | diverged).
Edge case: unknown id yields 404 not_found with a generic message.

item.name: Get letter - owned by another user (404)

request.description: Edge case: a letter that exists but belongs to {{otherEmail}}. LetterPolicy denies it and AccessService converts the denial into 404 so the API never reveals that the resource exists.
Edge case: letters#show passes include_archived: true, so the owner can still read an archived capsule. Run it after the archive request in folder 06.
Edge case: the catch-all route returns the standard JSON error envelope instead of an HTML 404 page.

exec: pm.test("JSON error contract even on unknown routes", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.have.property("requestId"));

request.description: Happy path: moves the letter to the archived state and returns the serialized letter. Stores {{archivedLetterId}}.
Happy path: archived -> pending.
Edge case: the letter was just restored, so can_restore? is false and the service returns 422 with code cannot_restore.
Re-archive after a restore, leaving the letter archived so folder 08 can delete it.

item.name: Archive letter - delivered is terminal (422 cannot_archive_delivered)

request.description:
Edge case: delivered is a terminal state with no outgoing transitions.

Prerequisite: set {{deliveredLetterId}} to a delivered letter. In development: bin/rails runner 'l = Letter.pending.first; l.update!(status: "delivered", delivered_at: Time.current)'. Skip this request if you have no delivered letter.
Edge case: unknown id on a state-changing endpoint still returns 404 not_found.

Happy path: writes the retrospective emotional ledger and the reality of each prediction.

Replace PREDICTION_ID_1 / PREDICTION_ID_2 with ids from the letter payload (data.predictions[].id). Prediction ids that do not belong to the letter are silently ignored.

Requires a letter that is not pending - the archived letter from folder 06 works.

exec: pm.test("predictions carry a boolean matched flag", () => pm.expect(body.data.predictions[0].matched).to.be.a("boolean"));

item.name: Update predictions - reveal out of range (422)

request.description: Edge case: reveal values must be integers within 1..10. letter.update! raises RecordInvalid, which the service converts to 422 validation_failed.
Edge case: a pending letter has not been delivered yet, so revealing it is 404 not_found (the service treats pending as non-existent for reveals).
Edge case: unknown letter id.
Happy path: permanent deletion is only allowed for archived letters (can_delete?). Responds 204 with an empty body and writes an audit log entry.
Edge case: a pending (not archived) letter cannot be deleted - archive it first.
Edge case: unknown id.
Edge case: the letter was already destroyed by the previous request, so the lookup fails with 404.
Happy path: sends a signed verification token (15 min) to the current email. The change only applies after GET /account/confirm_email?token=...

item.name: Request email change - same email (422 same_email)

request.description: Edge case: the new address equals the current one; the service returns the custom code same_email.

item.name: Request email change - invalid email (422 validation_failed)

request.description: Edge case: malformed address; the service returns code :invalid which maps to 422 validation_failed.
Edge case: account endpoints are authenticated; no token returns 401.
Edge case: an unknown or tampered verification token maps to 401 unauthorized (invalid_token).

Happy path: migrates letters, session tokens and audit logs from the old address to the new one and signs the caller in. Paste the token from the verification email into {{emailConfirmToken}}.

Returns 401 with an empty token variable.
Happy path: revokes the bearer token server-side and clears the cookie. After this call every other authenticated request returns 401 - run it when you are done.
Edge case: the token no longer exists, so the request itself is unauthorized.

Destructive: permanently deletes the account, all of its letters, session tokens and analytics events.

Requires a valid session, so re-run folder 02 (Request magic link -> Exchange token) first if you already destroyed it above.
Edge case: unauthenticated account deletion is rejected.

item.name: Magic link throttle - 6th request in a minute (429)

request.description:
Rack::Attack allows 5 POST /api/v1/sessions per IP per minute. Run this request 6 times within a minute (Postman Runner, 6 iterations) to see 429 rate_limited with a Retry-After header.

Disabled in development (Rack::Attack.enabled = false).

item.name: Letters throttle - 11th request in a minute (429)

request.description:
Rack::Attack allows 10 POST /api/v1/letters per IP per minute. Run this request 11 times within a minute to see 429 rate_limited.

Disabled in development.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Carta de prueba de limite",
  "email": "{{testEmail}}",
  "content": "Contenido suficientemente largo para pasar la validacion de longitud y probar unicamente el limite de peticiones por minuto del throttler.",
  "scheduled_at": "2027-03-01 09:00",
  "timezone": "America/Bogota",
  "language": "es"
}
